builds.name: Reference: Attack-led side lane
builds.goal: Reference for Irelia: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: An attack-driven diver who prepares passive stacks, marks targets and uses Q resets through a wave or duel. Start passive stacks fresh and distinguish marked/minion Q resets from ordinary Q. Can an AP Spellblade experiment repay lost AD/defense? Confirm Q interaction before granting on-hits. Real attacks can exploit BotRK and Spellblade while Hullbreaker asks for side-lane pressure.
builds.summary: Real attacks can exploit BotRK and Spellblade while Hullbreaker asks for side-lane pressure.
testPlan: Kit question for Irelia: Start passive stacks fresh and distinguish marked/minion Q resets from ordinary Q. Can an AP Spellblade experiment repay lost AD/defense? Confirm Q interaction before granting on-hits.

Start with the early core (BotRK or Trinity, then the other) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Real attacks can exploit BotRK and Spellblade while Hullbreaker asks for side-lane pressure. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Irelia dashes forward to strike her target, healing herself. If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Attack access and waves are necessary; attack items do not automatically empower every spell.

The route fails Irelia's stated kit question: Start passive stacks fresh and distinguish marked/minion Q resets from ordinary Q. Can an AP Spellblade experiment repay lost AD/defense? Confirm Q interaction before granting on-hits.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Attack access and waves are necessary; attack items do not automatically empower every spell.
Full cost 17,233 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: BotRK or Trinity, then the other. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Hullbreaker, Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Defiant Ap Stance
builds.summary: Compare W reduction and charged damage at fixed incoming patterns.
builds.goal: Compare W reduction and charged damage at fixed incoming patterns.
builds.hypothesis: W physical reduction has AP scaling and magic reduction is half of it; fully charged W reaches 1.5 AP physical damage, while E/R each have 1 AP magic ratios. Riftmaker AP/health and Zhonya test a defensive countercast sequence; penetration supports E/R rather than W.
testPlan: Required state: Charge W into controlled incoming damage and then connect E/R.
Compare W reduction and charged damage at fixed incoming patterns; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Standing still invites control and sacrificing AD lowers Q/attack healing.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: W's AP damage ratio does not make its damage magic.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Riftmaker, Zhonya's Hourglass, Cosmic Drive, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Q reset on Unsteady gives access; Nashor/Dusk tests actual attack damage after E mark without claiming Q inherits every item on-hit. W and health/resists preserve the attack window.
